race.comment: Looks a handy maiden, this. Some good types engaged. HONOUR THE BASSETT (5), is from the powerful Moody/Coleman camp and has looked good on-pace in two recent jumpout wins. Racing handy is generally an advantage here and he's drawn to take up a position. STOMPING GROUND (7) contested two handy races in the debut prep and thrashed his rivals in a recent trial, so he looks to have come on from them. WHAT ONCE WAS (12) was beaten in a three-way photo last start and could benefit on the race experience edge over a few rivals here. CELESTARIA (8) was okay in her debut prep but looks to have come on well during the break and can play a major role.
